Bio

Free to reprint
Short · 50 words

Akashic Monk is an independent hip-hop artist from Cleveland, Ohio, and founder of Akashic Entertainment®. Since 2016 the Monk has released 41 records, including the 22-track album Static Signal, blending heavy 808s, spiritual lyricism and pop-rock energy with a builder's mindset: code, crypto and gaming. American Blueprint arrives Winter 2026.

Long · press & radio

Born and built in the 216, Akashic Monk makes music the Cleveland way: independent, relentless and bigger than the block. The catalog began in 2016 with records like "Simulation" and "Me," grew through the Road to 2020 collections, and landed full projects in DarkLight, Soul Savior and Thoughts of a Wizard, with collaborators including NoBa'D, DNA88, EDC Jay, I.Am.PJ, Th3 Eye, Flamez, Dmatrix and SquadGod.

In 2026 the Monk shipped eleven new singles and Static Signal, a 22-track album, while writing code, making AI-driven music videos, running a crypto build series on YouTube, and building Order of the Akasha, a fantasy universe told through music, film and gaming.

Next comes American Blueprint, the plan drawn up from the ground floor, arriving Winter 2026.

Bars, blocks and blockchains.

The story angle: one Cleveland artist running the whole operation, from the beats and the bars to the site, the visuals, the crypto series and the game world.

Order of the Akasha

Concept art · credit Akashic Entertainment®

A story of guardians, mystic warriors and the living library of all knowledge, told through music, film and gaming. "Create. Build. Evolve. As One We Stand Together."

The novels · by Akashic Monk

The Book of ScrollsKindle The Book of ScrollsPaperback · ISBN 9798305044096 Origin's of AkirKindle

Two destined monks, Akir and Ayi, cross a fractured multiverse to save the Akasha, the force that governs every element and dimension. Akir wields the DarkLight Halo (a nod to the 2020 album DarkLight); Ayi channels elemental energy.
